name: Renewly Lite: Subscriptions and Memberships
author: Ecom Swift LLC

sections.description:
Renewly Lite turns any WooCommerce product into a subscription and lets you sell access to member-only content, in one fast plugin. Everything listed here is included and works out of the box.

Subscriptions

  • Subscription products: bill every N days, weeks, months or years, with an optional sign-up fee and an optional number of payments to stop after. Works on simple and variable products.
  • Renewal orders created on schedule and emailed with a secure pay link. Works with every payment method you already use.
  • Optional quantities: sold one at a time by default, with a single setting to let customers buy more than one.
  • A Subscriptions screen with filters, search, an activity timeline and manual controls.
  • My Account area: customers see their subscriptions, pay open renewals, cancel with an optional reason, or undo a pending cancellation.
  • Emails: new subscription, renewal invoice, renewal reminder, cancelled and payment failed, plus admin notices.

Memberships

  • Plans granted by purchase or by an active subscription.
  • Restrict posts, pages, products and categories, with a shortcode and a block.
  • A member list in the admin.

Built for modern WooCommerce

  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage and the Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • No external requests, no tracking, no account needed.
  • Developer hooks for gateway adapters and add-ons, documented in docs/DEVELOPER-HOOKS.md inside the plugin folder.

If Renewly Lite saves you time, you can support its development with a donation. It is optional and nothing in the plugin depends on it.

Fonts and third-party code

Renewly bundles two typefaces, Instrument Serif and Instrument Sans, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. They are served from the plugin folder (assets/fonts), so your visitors and administrators make no request to Google or any other font host. The licence text is in assets/fonts/OFL.txt. The plugin contains no other third-party code and makes no external requests.

Automatic payments

This plugin creates renewal orders on time and emails a pay link. Charging a saved card automatically needs a payment gateway adapter that opts in with the essm_gateway_supports_auto_renewal filter and charges on the essm_charge_renewal_{gateway_id} action. The hooks are documented in docs/DEVELOPER-HOOKS.md in the plugin folder. Without an adapter, customers pay each renewal from the emailed link.

Privacy

The plugin stores subscription records (customer id, billing and shipping address copied from the order, schedule and status history) in your own database. It does not send data to any external service and does not track visitors.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate this plugin.
  3. Edit a product, open the General tab and tick Subscription.
  4. Open Subscriptions > Settings to review emails and cancellation options.
sections.faq:
Does it charge cards automatically?

Out of the box it creates renewal orders and emails a pay link. Automatic charging needs a gateway adapter; see the Automatic payments section.

Does it work with HPOS and the checkout block?

Yes. Both are declared and used.

Can I restrict content to members?

Yes. Create a plan under Subscriptions > Plans, then restrict a post, page, product or category, or wrap content in the Members only block.

What happens if I uninstall?

Nothing is deleted unless you tick “Delete all data on uninstall” in Settings first.
